passages.paragraph_text: So I started working with Valve Software about a year and a half ago. And when I got there, I was given the mandate to research everything video game related in the hardware space. So we started looking at input devices, output devices, virtual reality, augmented reality. It's called retro reflective, much like they use for road sites.
